newsitem.title: FINLAND: Aamulehti ups stake in MTV to 18.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Aamulehti ups stake in MTV to 18.5 pct.

text.p: Finnish media group Aamulehti Oy said on Wednesday that it had increased its stake in television company MTV Oy to 18.5 percent.
"In the past year Aamulehti has bought 7,959 shares from the markets. Aamulehti now owns 10,192 MTV shares or 18.5 percent of shares," Aamulehti said in a statement.
